wiki.title: Julia C. Howard
wiki.extract: Julia Craven Howard (born August 20, 1944) is a Republican member of the North Carolina General Assembly representing the state's seventy-seventh House district, including constituents in Forsyth and Davie counties. She is a realtor from Mocksville, North Carolina. She earned her degree from Salem College in two years.
